name: 11203 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11203 (Brooklyn) has 359 nonprofit organizations. 94 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11203 (Brooklyn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11203 (Brooklyn) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 97 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 97 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list public events
observations.text: 2 social and fraternal organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.
